cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.28% · WTI +2.63% · Brent -2.20% · NatGas +12.50%. 64% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +3.39%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Oilfield Services lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.39%; weakest is Oilfield Services at -2.32%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: VRT is the standout at +16.56%
cards.body: Leaders: VRT +16.56%, EOSE +7.14%, ARRY +5.01%, PWR +4.96%, NXT +4.53%. Laggards: ENPH -15.99%, SEDG -8.24%, BKR -7.37%, NOV -6.20%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: ENPH moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: ENPH is -16.06% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
